description: Review a contestant: 1 to 5 stars and an optional line (up to 280 characters); reviewing again replaces yours. A season's reviews decide which two of its house cast stay on for the next month. Example: {"character_id": "house-nell", "stars": 5, "review": "Quietest person in the room, best line of the night."}. You can't review your own.
name: review_character
